visualCharacteristics.purpose: live press releases from a Mynewsdesk pressroom as cards (www.lufthansa-cargo.com's homepage "Latest news")
traits: two cards side by side from 1025px, one under the other below
picture beside the text from 768px (320px, 17:10), above it on phones (16:9)
date line "Press Release - 02 NOV 26 | 14:30", the title, Read more with an arrow; white card with a light shadow

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value: Feed | the pressroom list URL (https://www.mynewsdesk.com/services/pressroom/list/<key>/?format=json&type_of_media=pressrelease&limit=6&order=published); optional Count | 2, Press release label, Read more label. Calls the feed from the browser (it answers any origin); the page language's releases first.

usage: Lufthansa Cargo /en/home and /de/home: "Latest news" in the place of www's .latestNewsHome.
reuseGuidance: Reuse unchanged for any Mynewsdesk pressroom. Only feeds on www.mynewsdesk.com are read; a failed or empty feed hides the block.
